caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a slatted back and a woven seat. The chair is primarily brown, indicating a wood material, with decorative green and yellow accents along the legs, rungs, and rails. The top rail of the chair back features a painted motif of a yellow and orange cornucopia set against green leaves and small flowers, bordered by additional green flourishes on both ends of the rail. The legs and rungs have multiple green and yellow rings for decoration. The seat is rendered in a lighter beige color and appears to be made of woven material, suggested by the visible texture. The entire chair is detailed with careful shading and naturalistic color variations to show depth and form. Handwritten text below the chair reads "Sketch - Hitchcock Chair - 1830" and "D. S. De Vault."
title: Hitchcock Side Chair
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
